fields.label: What this is
fields.options: AstroHQ asks the astrology API for an astrologer's charts: birth chart, dasha, panchang, KP and matching. It can ask through the hub, which passes the request on to the engine, or straight to the astrology API: the small service on this server, or an AWS Lambda function. Only the numbers the calculation needs are sent (date, time, latitude, longitude and the time zone), never a name.

fields.description: Off, AstroHQ asks the astrology engine nothing and no chart can be made.
fields.label: Charts Are Available

fields.description: Through the hub: the hub keeps count of the calls and passes each on to the engine. Straight: AstroHQ asks the astrology API itself, with the key set on that service.
fields.label: How AstroHQ Reaches It
fields.options:
Through the hub
Straight to the astrology API

fields.description: The hub's address, for example https://hub.example.com, or the astrology API's, for example http://127.0.0.1:8795 for the service on this server. It must start with https:// (an address on this computer may start with http://).
fields.label: Address

fields.description: The key the hub gave to AstroHQ, or, going straight, the key set on the astrology API. It is kept encrypted and is never shown again.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: The name the astrology API has in the hub's API Registry.
fields.label: Name of the API in the Hub

fields.description: How long to wait for an answer before giving up (5 to 60). A chart takes about a second; the first one after a quiet time can take a few.
fields.label: Wait for an Answer (seconds)
